minutes.headline: Water commissioners authorized the superintendent to sign the ARPA grant agreement with the town and approved the annual meeting articles.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Water District Commissioners approved prior minutes, designated the superintendent as ARPA point of contact, and accepted the warrant articles for the March 30th annual meeting. Old business covered the Mass Ave water main permit, pilot studies, and a mailing about a billing change. A possible engineering survey for a main to the LCRA was floated, with no vote.

public_comment.topic: Chair invited public comment; none was offered.

votes.motion: Authorize the superintendent to enter into the ARPA grant agreement with the town and handle the correspondence and reporting
Accept the articles for the March 30th annual meeting

budget_items.topic: ARPA grant agreement with the town
budget_items.what_was_said: The town requires a named contact who sends monthly invoices and progress reports for ARPA funding.
The operating budget is funded by revenue from water sales and used for operational expenses.
Each year a sum is taken from the water enhancement account for materials and equipment for water main repairs.
An appropriation from surplus revenue would replace the superintendent's vehicle, which has very high mileage and is about nine years old.
The court has settled and the defendants must pay; the share each party gets is still to be determined.
Colour ink for the bill insert costs a little more than black; the board judged the colour not worth the extra.

budget_items.topic: Engineering survey for main to LCRA
budget_items.what_was_said: No price has been received yet; the superintendent suggested possibly funding the survey from the water improvements money, with no vote taken.

transfers.description: Possible use of the water improvements account (Article 5 money) to pay for an engineering survey; the pilot test was also mentioned as a source

decisions.decision: The superintendent will be the district's point of contact for ARPA invoices and progress reports to the town.
The bill insert will be printed in black rather than colour, going out with the April bills.
A notice will also be posted in The Ledger and on Facebook and repeated through April to June.
No vote on the engineering survey to the LCRA until a price is received.

what_happened.line: Water commissioners voted to authorize the superintendent to enter the ARPA grant agreement with the town and handle its correspondence and reporting.
Commissioners voted to accept the articles for the March 30th annual meeting, after voting to accept and sign the warrants.
The board chose to print the billing-change insert in black rather than colour, to go out with the April bills, with notices in The Ledger and on Facebook through June.
A possible engineering survey for a main to the LCRA was discussed; no vote will be taken until a price is received.

why_it_matters: Water customers will vote at the March 30th annual meeting on the articles the commissioners accepted, including the operating budget funded from water sales, a transfer for main repairs, and a replacement vehicle.

The ARPA agreement ties district invoices and progress reports to the town's reporting requirements, and a possible main to the LCRA is not yet costed or funded, so it is not yet a proposal residents can weigh.
